Chapter 741: Chapter 28: Majestic Heavenly Mountain (Please Subscribe)_3

Furthermore, the Star Alliance’s cut reached sixty percent; the more benefits Human Civilization obtained, the more the Star Alliance would receive.

“Let’s wait and see,” Xia Qin Supreme Being said with a smile.

Without Lin Yuan, he probably would have already cooperated with the Star Alliance.

After all, those wonders within the Two-dimensional World were meaningless to the clans unless brought out.

Even if the Star Alliance took a cut and Human Civilization only received forty percent, it was better than nothing.

“Wait and see?” This Star Alliance Supreme Being looked at Xia Qin Supreme Being, “Does the human Evolver who fell into the Two-dimensional World possess Eleventh Rank Perfect Life?”

...

Two years ago, when Xia Qin Supreme Being replied “let me think it over,” this Star Alliance Supreme Being was just a bit puzzled.

But now, with the Heavenly Gate about to open and Xia Qin Supreme Being still replying “let’s wait and see,” a Supreme Being of the Star Alliance was no fool.

He immediately conjectured two possibilities.

One was that the Human Civilization Alliance had already cooperated with other powers and entrusted the task of bringing out the oddities to these allies.

The other was that the human Evolver who fell into the Two-dimensional World was confident enough to compete for the strongest, hopeful of obtaining a place to enter the Heavenly Gate.

Compared to the first possibility, the Star Alliance Supreme Being was more inclined to believe the second.

After all, so far, he had a good idea of which forces possessed powerhouses close to the Four Divine Kings within the Two-dimensional World.

It was very unlikely for Human Civilization to cooperate with them, and even if they did cooperate, the cut would certainly be much higher than what the Star Alliance required.

Human Civilization had no need to make things difficult by looking too far.

“You all know about the Eleventh Level Perfected Evolver from my Human Civilization Alliance, don’t you?” Xia Qin Supreme Being retorted.

He did not disclose anything about Lin Yuan, not even a hint of information.

In the Two-dimensional World, the higher the profile, the more dangerous it was, as it made one an easy target for concerted attacks.

The Four Divine Kings were like this, but they had Supreme weapons integrated into their bodies, ensuring they could withstand an attack even if surrounded.

“You’ll know when the time comes.”

The Star Alliance Supreme Being pondered for a moment and then stopped thinking further.

Even if Human Civilization truly had an Eleventh-Rank Perfected Evolver in the Two-dimensional World, it was unlikely they could rival the Four Divine Kings.

Even without the Four Divine Kings, it would still be difficult to match those other Eleventh-Rank Perfect legendary lives.

In terms of pure combat power, human Evolvers were generally at a disadvantage against powerful special beings within the same rank.

Eighth Layer Evolvers creating their Inner World narrowed the gap between them and special beings, but it was only a narrowing.

…

Deep underground.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged; his aura was completely retracted, almost merging with the surrounding soil, but within his flesh, every drop of blood was exceedingly viscous, and his flesh and internal organs were nearly strong to an unimaginable degree.

“The 50th Realm of the Witch Ancestor.”

Lin Yuan straightened up slightly, and the sound of his bones colliding was like thunder, twisting the air around him.

“It’s time to go.”

Lin Yuan slowly stood up and threw a gentle punch, a terrifying force piercing dozens of miles, creating a wide passage between his current position and the ground surface.

“My current strength, I wonder how it compares to the Four Divine Kings with their Supreme weapons?”

Lin Yuan thought to himself. In terms of realm, he was confident he surpassed the Four Divine Kings, but his combat power was uncertain as the opponent had a refined Supreme weapon.

Nobody knew how powerful it could be in this Two-dimensional World.

“Two hundred years… Ever since a hundred years ago when I stepped into the 40th Realm of the Witch Ancestor, I’ve felt my progress slowing down, spending a full hundred years going from the Forty Realms to the 50th.”

Lin Yuan sighed.

The closer to the limit, the more difficult it was to take another step forward.

“Never mind.”

“There are still two months before the Heavenly Gate opens.”

“I can set off now.”

With a single step, Lin Yuan appeared on the ground surface moments later.

“This trip to the Heavenly Mountain, I’ll see the strength of other powerhouses. If they are all far weaker than me, I’ll sweep through and enter the Heavenly Gate directly.”

“If there are those whose combat power is close to mine, I’ll give up the opportunity for this opening of the Heavenly Gate and wait for the next one in ten thousand years.”

Lin Yuan set a plan for himself. The longer the time, the stronger his power would grow. In terms of realm advancement, Lin Yuan had Against-Heaven’s Understanding, undoubtedly far surpassing the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses. Even Eleventh Rank Perfect legendary lives were far inferior to him.

So there was no need for him to compete with other powerhouses during this opening period of the Heavenly Gate.

…

“Go straight to Heavenly Mountain.”

“There is no need to stop by the Luo River Gathering Ground or the Xueyu Ancient Country Capital.”

After settling on a direction, Lin Yuan strode forward.

Ever since stepping into the Witch Ancestor’s Twentieth Realm, Lin Yuan rarely appeared in the Luo River Gathering Ground because his strength was too formidable—mishandling it could lead to catastrophic consequences for the gathering ground.

And the Xueyu Ancient Country Capital, apart from visiting in the early years, Lin Yuan hardly ever went back.

More than ten days later.

Lin Yuan was about to reach Heavenly Mountain.

“On this journey, I’ve already sensed the presence of quite a few Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses.”

Lin Yuan thought quietly to himself. The vast majority of the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses came in groups. Over the past two hundred years, strong powerhouses from the Myriad Clans had often hunted other tribes, so those who survived now were grouped together.

Those Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses who did not group up were mostly very confident, most likely Tier 11 beings.

Since the descent of the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses into this Two-dimensional World, more than three hundred years had passed, and no more than two hundred thousand of them were still alive.

Among those two hundred thousand, there were just over two hundred Tier 11 powerhouses, down by one-third from just over three hundred in the beginning.

A moment later.

Lin Yuan finally arrived at Heavenly Mountain.

“Is that Heavenly Mountain?”

Lin Yuan stopped in his tracks, gazing at the distant towering mountain and his expression became slightly more solemn.
